Section C.3 and C.4.2 require shielding performance consistent with products on the General Services Administration Approved Products List for Federal Information Processing Standard 201 card protectors, and those products are tested at 13.56 megahertz. These are different frequency bands and a product qualified at one does not necessarily perform at the other. The 860–960 MHz UHF RFID blocking requirement governs acceptance for this solicitation. The references to FIPS 201- approved PIV card sleeves and GSA APL- listed FIPS 201-compliant card protectors are intended to establish a comparable level of shielding-performance benchmark for shielding in the UHF range. This does not replace the solicitation’s UHF RFID performance requirement. A product approved or tested to shield only at 13.56 MHz is not sufficient by itself unless the offered product also meets the solicitation requirements for RFID blocking performance at 860–960 MHz. 3 Approved Products List status.
